evidence_kind: sanitized retained metadata and log trace; not camera, tracker, DNN or hardware replay

provenance.revision_basis: event/classification provenance, not an attestation of the later live process

sources.fields_used: historical event subset and reacquisition diagnostics
capture identity, source time, submission/completion times, model identity and recorded latency
coasting, timeout, classification persistence and rejected decision; full-precision classifier confidence

provenance.sanitization: No images, calibration, model bytes, host/user paths or unrelated log records retained. SHA-256 values identify the full original artifacts, not this reduced fixture.

derived_replay.method: Translate retained monotonic source/coasting/timeout offsets to origin 100; deliver semantics 0.25 seconds after timeout. Delivery time is synthetic and deliberately keeps classification younger than the unchanged 3-second bound. It is not reconstructed original completion monotonic time. The observed UTC ordering separately establishes that actual classification completed after timeout.
derived_replay.coverage: Expired target association rejects an otherwise qualifying fresh legacy result before physical coordination or a durable actuation reservation. Also exercise expiry when the provider still exposes coasting. No person-clear result is fabricated.
